title: Experimental tasks
description: The in-core experimental mechanism for long-running work, using a blocking `tasks/result` call and a `tasks/list` enumeration.
question: Does this framework drive a task to completion?
why: This is the shape long-running work took before 2026-07-28 moved it into an extension and replaced blocking retrieval with polling.
usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP servers using this capability. Not estimated, so the panel stays empty until the corpus is scanned.
